author: legolas (UNKNOWN-RESEARCHER)
version: Diablo II: Lord of Destruction 1.13 txt data, expansion game. Not D2R. Where D2R differs it is flagged.
label: Every value in 'rows' is DATAMINED: copied verbatim (as strings) from the named file. Only non-empty columns are kept.

formula_evaluation_rule.lnXY: ParamX + (slvl - 1) * ParamY. SkillCalc.txt's own comment reads 'a+lvl*b'; D2MOO D2Skills.cpp evaluates it with (nSkillLevel - 1). The Arreat Summit and Basin tables reproduce only the (slvl - 1) form (asserted below).
formula_evaluation_rule.mana: ((mana + (slvl - 1) * lvlmana) << manashift) / 256, floored at minmana (D2MOO Skills.cpp D2GAME_SKILLMANA_Consume).
formula_evaluation_rule.skill_tohit: ToHit + (slvl - 1) * LevToHit, used as a % bonus to attack rating (D2MOO D2Skills.cpp case 20; SUNITDMG_IsHitSuccessful).

operand_rows.138 Shout: referenced by row 149 auralencalc: + skill('Shout'.blvl) * Param8 (duration synergy)
operand_rows.155 Battle Command: referenced by row 149 auralencalc: + skill('Battle Command'.blvl) * Param8 (duration synergy)
operand_rows.Missiles.txt battleorders (Id 237): row 149 srvmissilea / cltmissilea (the shout's area wave)
operand_rows.SkillDesc.txt whirlwind / battle orders: the tooltip formulas; they name the same calcs (clc1, toht, ln34, len)
operand_rows.ItemStatCost item_maxhp_percent / item_m: row 149 aurastat1-3. op 11 (hp/mana) and op 1 (stamina): how the % is applied
operand_rows.CharStats Barbarian: life/mana scaling operands (hpadd, LifePerLevel, LifePerVitality, ManaPerLevel, ManaPerMagic, ToHitFactor)
operand_rows.DifficultyLevels: ResistPenalty, LifeStealDivisor, ManaStealDivisor (used by the resist and leech laws)

kit_scope.row_151_operands: Row 151 references NO other skill row: calc1 = ln12 on its own Params, no synergy (EDmgSymPerCalc empty), no aurastat. Its prerequisites (reqskill1 Leap Attack, reqskill2 Concentrate) are tree gates, not operands.

considered_and_excluded.127 Sword Mastery / 128 Axe Mastery: Referenced by MECHANISM, not by row: D2MOO applies the matching weapon mastery's AR%, damage% and crit to any melee hit (SKILLS_GetWeaponMasteryBonus). Neither row 151 nor the kit record names a mastery; Maxroll's build maxes one. Included below under 'excluded_but_mechanism_relevant' so the adapter can see them; NOT kit scope. Note passiveitype: Sword Mastery only applies to 'swor', Axe Mastery only to 'axe'. A sword + axe loadout gets mastery on one hand only unless both are taken (INFERRED from passiveitype).
considered_and_excluded.152 Berserk: Named only as the kit record's scaffold variant ('Berserk variant for physical-immune'); not a kit skill.
considered_and_excluded.States.txt (aurastate battleorders, whir: Not in the local datamine; not acquired. UNKNOWN whether it carries anything load-bearing beyond the overlay/state flags.

per_level_tables.levels_the_kit_record_uses: NONE. The kit record d2-ww-barb.json names Whirlwind and Battle Orders but pins no skill level, character level, or +skills. Full 1-60 tables are given; the adapter picks the level.

gear_rows.note: The runewords and bases the kit record names (dossier.item_alterations / capstone_alterations), resolved in the 1.13 tables. A runeword's full property set = its Runes.txt T1 codes + the weapon-socket mods (Gems.txt) of each rune. Property code -> stat mapping is Properties.txt. *_perlevel stats use ItemStatCost op 2, op param 3: value * clvl / 8.

Grief.identification_note: 1.13 Runes.txt has no row whose 'Rune Name' is 'Grief'. Grief is identified by its rune sequence Eth-Tir-Lo-Mal-Ral (r05 r03 r28 r23 r08) at row key Runeword47, whose 'Rune Name' column reads 'Widowmaker'. The in-game name comes from the string table keyed on the row key, which this packet did not read. Identification = rune sequence + property match (+340-400 damage, 30-40% IAS, ignore target defense, Venom proc) against Basin/Maxroll Grief.
